title: Student Absence Note Checklist
subtitle: Document reported absence dates, attendance coding, missed work, and the return or correction route.
description: Keeps the student, guardian source, absence period, attendance code, missed-work route, return condition, and any record correction in one attendance-office record.
use_case: Use when a family reports a student absence or asks the school to correct the attendance record. Do not request medical detail that the school does not need. Attendance coding and required documentation follow the school's applicable policy.

sections.title: Student Absence Note starting details
sections.guidance: Capture absence start and end dates, guardian source, attendance code, missed-work delivery, return condition, documentation status, and correction request.

blocks.label: Student Absence Note people and reference

sections.title: Student Absence Note checks and corrections
sections.guidance: Check current student absence note facts at point of use.

blocks.label: Student Absence Note required checks
items: Absence dates is identified for this record
Guardian source matches the current request or source
Attendance code is ready for point-of-use staff
Missed-work route limits or questions are resolved
Return condition is communicated to the responsible person
Record correction is confirmed at handoff
A changed student absence note fact is returned for review

blocks.label: Student Absence Note failed or pending items

sections.title: Student Absence Note decision and readiness
sections.guidance: Hold student absence note readiness on any failed or pending item.

blocks.label: Student Absence Note reviewer receipt

fields.label: Responsible teacher or program coordinator and date

blocks.guidance: Student Absence Note receipt confirms the visible checklist result.
